text:
zoe: flagging an onboarding sample bug: works in node but fails in edge build with "Class extends value undefined". only after adapter bundling.
zoe: repo + minimal configs in the thread.
zoe: package.json excerpt: 
```
{
  "type": "module",
  "exports": { "import": "./dist/sdk.mjs", "default": "./dist/sdk.cjs" }
}
```
zoe: tsconfig: 
```
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "module": "ESNext",
    "target": "ES2020",
    "moduleResolution": "bundler",
    "declaration": true
  }
}
```
rahul: bundlers often inline CJS shims; if your package has conditional runtime requires the bundler can transform them and end up with undefined. sometimes that breaks subclass prototype chains.
mina: did you try removing the CJS fallback for the sample? Shipping ESM-only samples for edge is usually safer.
greg: also check for tiny polyfills the shim pulls in. we've seen a `self` reference from a fallback which crashes in some edge runtimes.
zoe: we tried toggling esModuleInterop. it fixed runtime but then several overloads in SDK tests started failing because inference changed.
rahul: separate concerns: runtime interop vs typing DX. For typing, `unknown` generics are correct but terrible for JS users who expect inference/autocomplete. two pragmatic patterns:
1) provide a JS-friendly overload returning Record<string, any> without generics, then a generic overload for TS users. e.g. 
```
request(path: string, body?: any): Promise<Record<string, any>>;
request<T = unknown>(path: string, body?: unknown): Promise<T>;
```
2) add convenience helpers in SDK like `client.json<T = unknown>(...)` and `client.any(...)` for untyped JS ergonomic calls.
mina: +1. Also change sample tsconfig.moduleResolution to `node16`. `bundler` can cause surprising export rewrites with some toolchains; node16 tends to be more predictable for modern bundlers.
greg: immediate sample fixes that have worked for us: a) update package.json to import-only ESM for the sample, b) set tsconfig moduleResolution to node16, c) remove CJS runtime shim from sample build, d) add a small README example showing typed helper usage.
zoe: that should fix runtime and improve DX. for the SDK, which default should we pick for the generic type param? `any` or `unknown`?
rahul: default to `unknown` for strictness but add the overload for JS users. keep internal types strict. for public convenience helpers, default to `any` so vanilla JS gets autocomplete.
mina: also request a CI smoke job: build the sample as ESM and run it in a local edge runtime (vercel dev or deno deploy) to catch these problems before merging.
greg: devx-bot can you file the CI ticket and assign to Zoe?
devx-bot: created issue #1370: "ci: smoke-test ESM-only edge onboarding sample in local edge runtime" labels: devex/ci, priority/medium. Assigned to @zoe.
zoe: opening PR to: change sample exports to import-only ESM, switch tsconfig resolution to node16, add `client.json` helper in SDK, and include a short README snippet showing `await client.request<{embedding:number[]}>(...)` and the JS variant `await client.json('/embed', {q})`. will include a post-build test asserting the exported class is constructible.
mina: when you update typings include a small TS example in the PR description so reviewers can see inference improvements.
rahul: thanks 7— also add a short changelog note: "samples: prefer ESM-only artifacts and provide JS-friendly typing overloads" to help downstream consumers.
zoe: will do. ping when PR is up for review.
